get.description: view_accounting; half-open periods <=366d each; automatic previous equal-duration period unless BOTH compare bounds supplied. CSV is current page. ABC: same-store revenue, descending stable ID tie-break, previous cumulative <80% A/<95% B/otherwise C. Not profit, bank receipt, cross-business ranking or automatic seasonal model. Different durations suppress percent change. Maximum100000 source rows; invalid stored dates fail explicitly.

post.description: manage_production + view_accounting. batches required. Other fields optional but supplied null invalid. Labor/overhead refer to ENTIRE RUN. minutes0..525600,workers1..10000,hourly cost nonnegative. Omitted components unknown. Contribution only when labor AND overhead supplied; price0 has no margin percent. Margin basis-points truncate toward zero. Current-material/user-assumption estimate, never actual historical cost or net profit.

post.description: manage_stock + manage_replenishment. All six fields required. Existing human restock policy required; no creation. 1h..366d demand window. lead0..365d,coverage1..365d,safety nonnegative. Current stock across up to500 local-store locations, less reservations; max100000 sale item rows. Unit products ceil to whole units. Suggested minimum=max(policy_min,ceil(daily*lead+safety));target=max(policy_target,ceil(daily*(lead+coverage)+safety)); suggestion=max(0,target-free) only at/below minimum. Human approval still mandatory; never sends order or changes policy.
